1. Run the unit tests. If any fail, stop.
2. Bump the build number to today's date and time, in the project's existing format. Don't commit unless asked.
3. Do a dry run: `CLICKY_RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1 Tools/release.sh`. Continue only if it finishes without errors.
4. Run the real release with `Tools/release.sh`.
5. Back up `/Applications/Theo.app` to a dated folder before installing.
6. Install only when nothing is playing audio.
